name: Stormwind Ho!
summary: Alliance High Command fears the naga threat, and Stormwind Ho! gives Farren Orinelle a chance to leave Southshore. He hopes to take credit for their defeat and win a reassignment to Stormwind City.

sections.title: A Ticket Out of Southshore
sections.body: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle finds his Southshore posting miserable. The town sits on Lordaeron’s edge, hemmed in by Forsaken forces, syndicate brigands, and sea fiends. A city guardsman used to drunks and petty brawls in Stormwind, Farren longs to return south. His former mentor tells him Alliance High Command is increasingly anxious about naga encroaching on the coasts. Farren sees a chance to leave the north behind.

sections.title: Stolen Valor on the Coast
sections.body: Farren admits he lacks the courage and skill to face Daggerspine sirens and shorehunters in open combat. He commissions you to scour the beaches southeast of Southshore and cull the naga ranks. He needs your martial feats to write an impressive dispatch to Major Samuelson in Stormwind, and hopes the credit will help him secure a reassignment.

faq.q: Why does Farren Orinelle want to kill the naga?
faq.answer: Farren wants to escape Southshore, not because he personally cares about the naga. His mentor told him Alliance High Command fears their rising threat, so success against them could bring promotion or a transfer back to Stormwind City.

faq.q: Can Lieutenant Farren Orinelle fight the naga himself?
faq.answer: No. Farren is an urban guardsman used to breaking up drunken tavern brawls and arresting rowdy beggars. The savage Daggerspine naga frighten him, so he relies on visiting adventurers to fight them.

faq.q: Where are the Daggerspine naga located?
faq.answer: Daggerspine shorehunters and sirens have encampments along the coast southeast of Southshore. They prowl the shores of the Great Sea in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Major Samuelson is Farren Orinelle’s former mentor in the Stormwind City Guard. Farren hopes Samuelson will pull the strings to secure his transfer south as he prepares a report about the naga.

faq.q: What happens after completing this task?
faq.answer: After the naga threat is reduced, Farren takes credit for your work and sends you south to Stormwind Keep. You deliver his report and reassignment plea to Major Samuelson in person.

faq.q: Why does Farren hate Southshore so much?
faq.answer: Farren sees Southshore as a dangerous frontier outpost, far from Stormwind’s safety. With undead neighbors and coastal monsters all around, he bitterly calls it a “Light-forsaken port.”

angles.text: Alliance command in Hillsbrad is stretched thin, leaving ordinary city watchmen out of their depth against monstrous threats like the Daggerspine naga.
As a human serving in Lordaeron, you see Southshore as a grim reminder of lost northern glory, far from Stormwind’s rebuilt grandeur and safety.
